sloka: ततः स कार्मुकी वाणी समरे चाभिवर्तत ।लब्धसञ्ज्ञो मुहूर्तेन क्रुद्धस्तस्थौ यथान्तकः ।। ७.२१.४० ॥
transliteration: tataḥ sa kārmukī vāṇī samare cābhivartata ।labdhasañjño muhūrtena kruddhastasthau yathāntakaḥ ।। 7.21.40 ॥

translations.english: Then, the bow-wielding Indrajit, having regained consciousness in a moment, stood enraged in battle like the god of death.
